input.summary: The ticket describes a basic feature request to add a button to the helpdesk form view. The description is clear but missing several key details required before development can begin.

missing_info.text: User role that should see the button is not specified
Expected behaviour after button click is not described
No mention of which Odoo module or view is affected

acceptance_criteria.given: a logged-in helpdesk agent on the ticket form
acceptance_criteria.then: the configured action is triggered and a success toast appears

test_cases.description: Agent clicks button on an open ticket — action fires and toast shown
Button clicked on a closed ticket — action is blocked with an error message
User without helpdesk agent role cannot see the button

definition_of_ready.text: Affected Odoo view and model are identified
Button label and icon agreed with stakeholder
Action triggered by button is fully specified

definition_of_done.text: Button renders in the helpdesk ticket form view
Access rights verified for agent and non-agent roles
All acceptance criteria verified on staging

odoo_notes.text: Affects helpdesk.ticket form view — ir.ui.view XML change required
May require security rule update in helpdesk/security/ir.model.access.csv
